page_title: CAG 1-1 GEN | Cagliari v Genoa 07/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Michael Fabbri has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+1' Michael Fabbri shows a yellow card to Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.

89' What a chance that is! Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
87' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:2.
85' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Cagliari.
84' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
82' The resulting free kick from Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.

81' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.
80' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
79' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
78' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) replaces Adam Obert.
78' Here comes a substitution. Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Alessandro Deiola.
76' Genoa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
76' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag and Genoa will take a corner.
75' Patrick Vieira is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) suffers an injury and Ruslan Malinovsky comes on.
73' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is able to continue to play.
72' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
71' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:6.
68' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
66' We are about to witness a subsitution. Alan Matturro (Genoa) for Jeff Ekhator.
65' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.

64' Cagliari slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
61' Here comes a substitution. Nicolas Viola is given a rest as he is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
61' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Antoine Makoumbou will be replaced by Matteo Prati (Cagliari).
60' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.

59' Koni De Winter (Genoa) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
58' The resulting set piece from Genoa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

56' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball is behind the touchline and Cagliari will take a throw-in.
52' Patrick Vieira has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Patrizio Masini (Genoa) replacing Milan Badelj.
52' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Caleb Ekuban walks off the pitch to be replaced by Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa).
51' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 42:58.
48' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Milan Badelj (Genoa) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
47' 1 - 1 Goal! Maxwel Cornet (Genoa) scores after an assist by Caleb Ekuban that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:1.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Patrick Vieira decided to make a change. Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) is replaced by Alessandro Zanoli.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+1' A rebound falls to Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
45+1' Genoa have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Genoa.
40' Dangerous play by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari). Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul.

38' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Genoa will have a goal kick.

35' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is knocked off balance by a defender near the penalty spot and sends his header from the corner well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
35' Aaron Martin (Genoa) is about to take a corner kick.
33' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Caleb Ekuban (Genoa), but the defence gets it clear.
31' Problems for Davide Nicola as Florinel Coman (Cagliari) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Tommaso Augello replaces him.
28' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
28' Looks like Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

26' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Genoa.
24' Genoa are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
22' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nicola Leali, who smothers the ball.
21' Cagliari are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

18' 1 - 0 Goal! Roberto Piccoli displays great vision and sends a pass to Nicolas Viola (Cagliari), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
18' Aaron Martin (Genoa) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

18' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Corner kick. Genoa will have an opportunity.
16' Florinel Coman (Cagliari) executes the set piece from the edge of the box in a brilliant manner. His terrific effort looks goal bound, but it only hits the right post!
14' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
12' Fabio Miretti (Genoa) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Elia Caprile produces a wonderful reflex save.
11' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
10' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
6' Genoa are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
2' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
